comments.author: johhnydollar
comments.text: Damnit…I was hanging in there…digging the potential of a Oscar Wilde meets Arthur Conan Doyle meets Bob Kane kinda read…but the homo-erotica was getting more and more overt…distracting me from an otherwise enjoyable story…and now this. I’m hesitant to continue and find acts I find unpleasant and unappealing presented as authentically as sex scenes in your other comics. That’s not me being burly guy, either…I have a fairly high homo-erotic tolerance…I’m afraid this comic is going to exceed my threshold, though.

comments.author: johhnydollar
comments.text: I’m going to have to balance my reading of this with frequent clicks on the “breasts” tag. : )
